method: Source reading of kernel island scripts. Not a browser certification.

islands.keyboard: Escape closes the drawer and focus moves into the panel. Tab is not captured, so this is not a keyboard trap. Focus is not restored to the toggle.
islands.gap: Focus restoration is unimplemented. Manual check still pending.

islands.keyboard: Arrow keys move and select tabs. Home and End are not implemented.
Uses the native dialog element, which supplies a focus trap and Escape. A close control is wired.
islands.gap: Manual screen-reader naming of the image swap is pending.

islands.keyboard: Previous and next buttons and arrow keys. No autoplay in the island script. Button names depend on the site markup.
islands.gap: Unnamed buttons would fail the form/name check in page markup, not in this script.

islands.keyboard: Arrow keys change the slider. Pointer drag is also present.
